objects.name: IC2574
objects.query: SELECT TOP 150 source_id,ra,dec,pmra,pmdec,ref_epoch,phot_g_mean_mag FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',157.11541666666665,68.4165,0.2)) AND phot_g_mean_mag<18 AND parallax_over_error>5 AND ruwe<1.4 ORDER BY phot_g_mean_mag
